patch_description: Crossover of the two 0.80-scoring seeds: keeps the extreme parameter economy of a single shared scalar "theta" driving every rotation (n_params = 8 total across the 8 block repetitions), while combining the best structural elements from both parents. From the RX+RY+RZ seed we take the richer per-qubit rotation sequence (RX then RY before entangling, RZ after), which gave the fastest convergence (60 steps). From the p_shared seed we take the denser dual-ring entangling topology (nearest-neighbor CZ ring + skip-2 CZ ring, both with wrap-around), which gave the lowest validation/test loss (0.01) thanks to higher connectivity. Combining both should retain the 1.00 accuracy with zero generalization gap while pushing for both fast convergence and low loss, at the same minimal 8-parameter budget as both parents (better parameter economy than the 14-param variant, which scored lower at 0.72).
